source_reads.read_classification: fresh full actual root manual source read

findings.contract: Cookie capture helpers reject malformed data
findings.evidence: HPACK integer shifts and additions and string cursor additions are unchecked; priority payload slicing assumes five bytes; a trailing partial frame header is accepted; hexadecimal pairs allow a sign; unknown value_huffman text becomes false.
findings.scope: Private test capture/recording helpers; malformed controls and native reproduction remain required. The string get in this hex decoder is already UTF8-safe.

findings.contract: Cookie exchange tasks have an owner through failure and cancellation
findings.evidence: Raw server handles cross fallible setup, request/body operations and outer cancellation. H2 request failure renders client and server errors into a string. H3 response failure can precede retained completed secondary observation.
findings.scope: Source-supported task ownership and typed-result contracts; no measured permanent leak or production client failure.

findings.contract: Cookie fixture deadlines and completion errors retain concrete causes
findings.evidence: H3 request/server Elapsed and done receiver failure are replaced by strings. H2 request/server errors are formatted together rather than retained as error objects.
findings.scope: Actual deadline/receiver/combined-error regression controls remain required.

findings.contract: Cookie H2 recording reports unexpected driver failures
findings.evidence: The actual connection poll_closed result is assigned to _closed and not examined before returning observations.
findings.scope: Source-supported observer gap; expected teardown and unrelated real transport-failure controls must establish a narrow remedy.

findings.contract: Cookie fixtures group imports and independent operations
findings.evidence: A local import leads standard/external imports; several independent decode/validation/next-operation sequences lack paragraph boundaries.
findings.scope: Manual readability assessment; no formatting-only behavioral tests needed.

preserve: Seven existing method names and all literal/profile/ALPN/order/representation assertions.
Actual decoded HEADERS order and cookie values/representations, including the 101-pair HTTP3 workflow.
RecordingIo already reports poisoned recording locks as io errors; its existing behavior must remain.
limitations: Source review only. No new native causal reproduction, remedy, performance measurement or independent approval.
Private fixture parsing does not establish a production request-parser vulnerability.
Runtime owner/driver boundaries need bounded resolved-source reading and concrete lifecycle controls before repair.
